\(\cos\theta=\frac45\), so
\[
\tan^2\theta=\frac{1-\cos^2\theta}{\cos^2\theta}
=\frac{1-\frac{16}{25}}{\frac{16}{25}}=\frac{9}{16}.
\]
Thus \(\tan\theta=\pm\frac34\). Since \(z\) is purely imaginary, its imaginary part must be nonzero:
\[
\sin\theta-\frac35\neq 0.
\]
If \(\tan\theta=\frac34\), then \(\sin\theta=\frac35\), giving imaginary part \(0\), so reject. Hence
\[
\tan\theta=-\frac34.
\]
Then
\[
\tan\left(\theta-\frac\pi4\right)
=\frac{\tan\theta-1}{1+\tan\theta}
=\frac{-\frac34-1}{1-\frac34}
=\frac{-\frac74}{\frac14}
=-7.
\]
